title: A proper affine finite-type scheme over a field is finite
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $X$ be a $k$-scheme. If the structure morphism $X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is both proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and affine, then it is finite.

source.place: Lemma Tag 01WN (lemma-finite-proper), together with the affine characterization of finite morphisms; used in the proof of Tag 0BEV
